    def _draw_3d(self, evaluation_result: dict):
        """v03: กราฟ 3D แทน heat map — CAD (wireframe จาง + วงผนัง CAD ทุกชั้นที่ตรวจ) + จุดที่วัดได้
        สีเขียว/แดงต่อจุด เลื่อนออกจากจุด CAD ตามระยะเบี่ยงจริง × k (ขยายให้เห็น) พร้อมเส้นเชื่อม
        และเส้นรอบรูปที่วัดได้ของแต่ละชั้น (× k) — ข้อความเหนือรูแสดงเฉพาะผลสำคัญ"""
        app = self.app
        app.fig.clf()
        app.fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.0, right=1.0, top=0.93, bottom=0.05)
        ax = app.fig.add_subplot(111, projection='3d', facecolor=theme.VIEW3D_BG)
        app.ax = ax
        holes_result = evaluation_result.get('holes', {}) or {}

        v, f = self._work_mesh()
        tri = v[f]
        nan = np.full((len(f), 1), np.nan)
        ax.plot(np.hstack([tri[:, [0, 1, 2, 0], 0], nan]).ravel(), np.hstack([tri[:, [0, 1, 2, 0], 1], nan]).ravel(),
                np.hstack([tri[:, [0, 1, 2, 0], 2], nan]).ravel(), color="#4f6d8f", linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.35)

        pts_all = [(gi, lyr, p) for gi, info in holes_result.items() for s in info.get('segments', [])
                   for lyr in s.get('layers', []) for p in lyr.get('points', [])]
        max_dev = max((abs(float(p.get('dev', p.get('distance_mm', 0.0)) or 0.0)) for _g, _l, p in pts_all), default=0.0)
        sizes = [lyr['circle']['nominal_diameter'] / 2 for _g, lyr, _p in pts_all if lyr.get('circle')] or [5.0]
        k = self._nice_scale(max_dev, float(np.median(sizes)))
        self._scale = k

        self._hole_artists = {}
        gidx = {gi: h for gi, h in enumerate(app.current_holes)}
        for gi, info in holes_result.items():
            ok_h = bool(info.get('passed'))
            arts = {'scatter': [], 'text': None}
            top = None
            for s in info.get('segments', []):
                for lyr in s.get('layers', []):
                    pts = lyr.get('points', [])
                    if not pts:
                        continue
                    E = np.array([p['expected'] for p in pts], dtype=float)
                    A = np.array([p['actual'] for p in pts], dtype=float)
                    M = E + k * (A - E)
                    c = lyr.get('circle')
                    if c:   # วงผนัง CAD ของชั้นนี้ (จาก fit จุด CAD — ตรงกับผิว CAD)
                        cc, r = np.asarray(c['nominal_center'], dtype=float), c['nominal_diameter'] / 2
                        t = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 73)
                        ax.plot(cc[0] + r * np.cos(t), cc[1] + r * np.sin(t), np.full_like(t, cc[2]),
                                color="#cfd8e3", linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.9)
                        cen = cc
                    else:
                        cen = E.mean(axis=0)
                        o = np.argsort(np.arctan2(E[:, 1] - cen[1], E[:, 0] - cen[0]))
                        ax.plot(*np.vstack([E[o], E[o[:1]]]).T, color="#cfd8e3", linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.9)
                    o = np.argsort(np.arctan2(M[:, 1] - cen[1], M[:, 0] - cen[0]))   # รูปร่างที่วัด (× k)
                    ax.plot(*np.vstack([M[o], M[o[:1]]]).T, color=_PASS_FACE if lyr.get('passed') else _FAIL_FACE,
                            linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.85, linestyle='--')
                    for e, m_ in zip(E, M):
                        ax.plot(*np.vstack([e, m_]).T, color="#e6e9ed", linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.7)
                    col = [_PASS_FACE if p.get('passed') else _FAIL_FACE for p in pts]
                    ax.scatter(*E.T, s=10, c="#cfd8e3", depthshade=False)
                    arts['scatter'].append(ax.scatter(*M.T, s=42, c=col, edgecolors="#111", linewidths=0.6,
                                                      depthshade=False))
                    top = max(top if top is not None else -1e9, float(E[:, 2].max()))
                    arts['xy'] = (float(cen[0]), float(cen[1]))
            if top is not None:
                x, y = arts['xy']
                _nf = info.get('total_points', 0) - info.get('passed_points', 0)
                lbl = (f"Hole {info.get('display_id', gidx.get(gi) and gidx[gi].display_id)}  "
                       + (f"PASS" if ok_h else
                          f"FAIL {_nf} pt{'s' if _nf != 1 else ''}"))
                arts['text'] = ax.text(x, y, 1.5, lbl, color=_PASS_FACE if ok_h else _FAIL_FACE, fontsize=10,
                                       weight='bold', ha='center', va='bottom', zorder=20)
                arts['base_color'] = _PASS_FACE if ok_h else _FAIL_FACE
            self._hole_artists[gi] = arts

        lo, hi = v.min(axis=0), v.max(axis=0)
        span = hi - lo
        ax.set_xlim(lo[0], hi[0]); ax.set_ylim(lo[1], hi[1]); ax.set_zlim(lo[2], max(hi[2], 2.0))
        try:
            ax.set_box_aspect((span[0], span[1], max(span[2], 2.0)))
        except Exception:
            pass
        ax.view_init(elev=28, azim=-60)
        for a in (ax.xaxis, ax.yaxis, ax.zaxis):
            a.set_pane_color((0, 0, 0, 0))
            a.label.set_color(theme.VIEW3D_MUTED)
        ax.tick_params(colors=theme.VIEW3D_MUTED, labelsize=7)
        ax.set_xlabel("X (mm)"); ax.set_ylabel("Y (mm)"); ax.set_zlabel("Z (mm)")

        n_pass = sum(1 for i in holes_result.values() if i.get('passed'))
        n_fail = len(holes_result) - n_pass
        tot, pas = evaluation_result.get('total_points'), evaluation_result.get('passed_points')
        app.fig.suptitle(f"Evaluation 3D — {n_pass} hole(s) passed, {n_fail} failed  |  {(tot or 0) - (pas or 0)} of {tot} points failed"
                         f"  |  deviation shown ×{k}", fontsize=12, color=theme.VIEW3D_TEXT)
        app.fig.text(0.01, 0.01, f"Grey circle = CAD wall at each probed layer · dot = measured point moved away from its "
                     f"CAD point by the real deviation × {k} (green pass / red fail) · dashed = measured outline × {k}",
                     fontsize=8, color=theme.VIEW3D_MUTED, ha='left', va='bottom')
        mismatch = evaluation_result.get('settings_mismatch') or []
        if mismatch:
            app.fig.text(0.01, 0.96, f"⚠ Settings changed since export for: {', '.join(str(m) for m in mismatch)}",
                         fontsize=8, color='#ffca28', ha='left', va='top')
        app.canvas.draw()

    def _draw_overview(self, evaluation_result: dict):
        """วาด mesh background + hole markers สีตามผลตรวจ (เขียว/แดง/เทา)
        พร้อมเส้นทางเดินเครื่อง (แบบเดียวกับ Path Mapper) เพื่ออ้างอิงลำดับ
        การโพรบจริง — ใช้แค่แสดงผล ไม่ใช้คำนวณ"""
        app = self.app
        ax  = app.ax

        gidx_of = {id(h): gi for gi, h in enumerate(app.current_holes)}

        selected_holes = [h for h in app.current_holes
                          if getattr(h, 'selected_for_inspection', False)
                          and h.x is not None and h.y is not None]

        if not selected_holes:
            self._draw_placeholder(
                "📍", "No holes are currently selected for inspection.")
            return

        holes_result = evaluation_result.get('holes', {})

        x, y, tris, fdata = app.current_x, app.current_y, app.current_triangles, app.current_face_data
        vmin, vmax = np.min(fdata), np.max(fdata)
        if vmin == vmax:
            vmax = vmin + 0.1

        ax.set_axis_on()
        ax.tripcolor(x, y, tris, facecolors=fdata, cmap=app.cmap,
                    edgecolors='none', vmin=vmin, vmax=vmax, alpha=0.55, zorder=1)

        # ลำดับการเดินเครื่อง (อ้างอิงเท่านั้น ใช้โมดูลเดียวกับ G-code จริง)
        try:
            from core.hole_ordering import order_holes_nearest_neighbor, split_step_ready
            ready, _skipped = split_step_ready(selected_holes)
            ordered = order_holes_nearest_neighbor(ready)
        except Exception:
            ordered = selected_holes

        if ordered:
            hx = [h.x for h in ordered]
            hy = [h.y for h in ordered]
            ax.plot(hx, hy, color='#546e7a', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.2,
                   alpha=0.6, zorder=3, marker=None)

        face_colors, edge_colors = [], []
        pass_count = fail_count = nodata_count = 0

        for h in selected_holes:
            gi   = gidx_of.get(id(h))
            info = holes_result.get(gi) if gi is not None else None
            if info is None:
                face_colors.append(_NODATA_FACE)
                edge_colors.append(_NODATA_EDGE)
                nodata_count += 1
            elif info.get('passed', False):
                face_colors.append(_PASS_FACE)
                edge_colors.append(_PASS_EDGE)
                pass_count += 1
            else:
                face_colors.append(_FAIL_FACE)
                edge_colors.append(_FAIL_EDGE)
                fail_count += 1

        hx_all = [h.x for h in selected_holes]
        hy_all = [h.y for h in selected_holes]

        scatter = ax.scatter(hx_all, hy_all, facecolors=face_colors, edgecolors=edge_colors,
                  marker='o', s=150, linewidths=2.2, zorder=5)

        for h in selected_holes:
            gi   = gidx_of.get(id(h))
            info = holes_result.get(gi) if gi is not None else None
            label = str(h.display_id)
            ax.text(h.x, h.y, label, color='black', fontsize=8,
                   weight='bold', ha='center', va='center', zorder=6)
            if info is not None and not info.get('passed', False):
                sub = f"{info.get('total_points', 0) - info.get('passed_points', 0)} fail"
                ax.text(h.x, h.y - 4, sub, color=_FAIL_FACE, fontsize=7,
                        ha='center', va='top', zorder=6)

        self._overview_scatter   = scatter
        self._overview_base_face = list(face_colors)
        self._overview_base_edge = list(edge_colors)
        self._overview_index_map = {gidx_of[id(h)]: i for i, h in enumerate(selected_holes)}

        # v02: no more "Overall Accuracy: X%" — replaced with a plain
        # failed/total points count sourced from evaluation_engine v02's
        # 'failed_points' field (Requirement 4).
        failed_pts = evaluation_result.get('failed_points')
        total_pts  = evaluation_result.get('total_points')
        passed_pts = evaluation_result.get('passed_points',
                                           (total_pts or 0) - (failed_pts or 0))
        pts_tag    = f"  |  {passed_pts} / {total_pts} points passed" if total_pts else ""
        ax.set_title(
            f"Evaluation — {pass_count} passed, {fail_count} failed, "
            f"{nodata_count} no data{pts_tag}",
            fontsize=13, color=theme.c(theme.TEXT))
        ax.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.3, color=theme.c(theme.PLOT_GRID))
        ax.set_xlabel("X-Axis (mm)", fontsize=11, color=theme.c(theme.TEXT))
        ax.set_ylabel("Y-Axis (mm)", fontsize=11, color=theme.c(theme.TEXT))

        if getattr(app, 'max_physical_dim', None) is not None and len(x) > 0:
            cx        = (np.min(x) + np.max(x)) / 2.0
            cy        = (np.min(y) + np.max(y)) / 2.0
            half_span = (app.max_physical_dim / 2.0) * 1.15
            ax.set_xlim([cx - half_span, cx + half_span])
            ax.set_ylim([cy - half_span, cy + half_span])
        ax.set_aspect('equal')

        mismatch = evaluation_result.get('settings_mismatch') or []
        if mismatch:
            names = ", ".join(str(m) for m in mismatch)
            ax.text(0.01, 0.99,
                   f"⚠ Settings changed since export for: {names} — results may not "
                   f"reflect the actual machine run.",
                   transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=8, color='#ffca28',
                   va='top', ha='left', zorder=15,
                   bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#1a1400',
                             edgecolor='#ffca28', alpha=0.85))

        ax.text(0.01, 0.01,
               "Green = all points within tolerance. Red = one or more points failed. "
               "Gray = no matching log data for this hole.",
               transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=8, color='#888888',
               va='bottom', ha='left', zorder=15)

        app.canvas.draw()

    def highlight_hole(self, global_idx):
        """เรียกจาก ui/main_window.py ตอน hover/click รูใน sidebar ขณะอยู่แท็บ
        Evaluation — ไฮไลต์ marker บน overview เดิม ไม่สลับหน้า (แบบเดียวกับ
        path_mapper_tab.py)"""
        arts = (self._hole_artists or {}).get(global_idx)   # v03: กราฟ 3D
        if arts is not None:
            self._highlighted_gidx = global_idx
            if arts.get('text') is not None:
                arts['text'].set_color(_HILITE_EDGE)
            for sc in arts['scatter']:
                sc.set_edgecolors(_HILITE_EDGE); sc.set_linewidths(1.6)
            self.app.canvas.draw_idle()
            return
        if self._overview_scatter is None:
            return
        local_idx = self._overview_index_map.get(global_idx)
        if local_idx is None:
            return

        self._highlighted_gidx = global_idx
        edge = list(self._overview_base_edge)
        edge[local_idx] = _HILITE_EDGE
        self._overview_scatter.set_edgecolors(edge)
        self.app.canvas.draw_idle()

    def clear_hole_highlight(self):
        arts = (self._hole_artists or {}).get(self._highlighted_gidx)   # v03: กราฟ 3D
        if arts is not None:
            if arts.get('text') is not None:
                arts['text'].set_color(arts.get('base_color', _PASS_FACE))
            for sc in arts['scatter']:
                sc.set_edgecolors("#111"); sc.set_linewidths(0.6)
            self._highlighted_gidx = None
            self.app.canvas.draw_idle()
            return
        if self._overview_scatter is None or self._highlighted_gidx is None:
            return
        self._highlighted_gidx = None
        self._overview_scatter.set_edgecolors(self._overview_base_edge)
        self.app.canvas.draw_idle()

def _alignment_for(app):
    """v25: ผลวัดเอียงจาก Set up — เฉพาะเมื่อเปิดใช้ และวัดกับไฟล์ CAD ที่โหลดอยู่"""
    al = getattr(app, 'part_alignment', None)
    if not al or not getattr(app, 'evaluation_align', True):
        return None
    return al if al.get('model') == getattr(app, 'loaded_step_filepath', None) else None

def corrections_status(app, result) -> tuple:
    """v29: การแก้ค่าที่ใช้จริงในผลนี้ → ([(หัวข้อ, ข้อความ)], [คำเตือน]) — ใช้ทั้งหน้า Evaluation และรายงาน PDF
    คำเตือน = การแก้ที่ควรใช้แต่ไม่ได้ใช้ (ไม่มีข้อมูล / ปิดไว้ใน Advanced) และ Best-fit centre ที่เปิดอยู่"""
    import math
    result = result or {}
    pp = app.probe_profile
    items, warns = [], []
    comp, rxy = result.get('compensation'), result.get('tip_radius_xy')
    if comp == 'on':
        if rxy:
            d = getattr(pp, 'effective_tip_xy_date', '') or ''
            items.append(("Tip compensation", f"r X {rxy[0]:.3f} / Y {rxy[1]:.3f} mm"
                          + (f" (Set up {d})" if d else "")))
            if not d:
                warns.append("X / Y tip: calibration date unknown — re-run Set up if the probe was remounted")
        else:
            items.append(("Tip compensation", f"r {result.get('tip_radius_mm', 0):.3f} mm, every direction"))
            if not getattr(app, 'evaluation_tip_xy', True):
                warns.append("Separate X / Y tip is OFF (Advanced corrections)")
            elif pp.effective_tip_radius_xy is None:
                warns.append("X / Y tip not calibrated — one radius used for every direction (run Set up)")
    elif comp == 'unavailable':
        warns.append("Tip compensation unavailable — schema has no probe directions (re-export G-code)")
    else:
        warns.append("Tip compensation OFF — raw ball centre compared with CAD")
    al = result.get('alignment')
    if al:
        kx, ky = al.get('lean', (0.0, 0.0))
        gx, gy = al.get('slope', (0.0, 0.0))
        t = (getattr(app, 'part_alignment', None) or {}).get('time')
        items.append(("Tilt / lean / rotation",
                      f"top tilt {math.degrees(math.atan(math.hypot(gx, gy))):.2f}° · "
                      f"Z lean {math.degrees(math.atan(math.hypot(kx, ky))):.2f}° · "
                      f"rotation {math.degrees(al.get('yaw_rad', 0.0)):+.2f}°"
                      + (f" (Set up {t:%H:%M})" if hasattr(t, 'strftime') else "")))
    elif not getattr(app, 'evaluation_align', True):
        warns.append("Tilt / Z lean / rotation correction is OFF (Advanced corrections)")
    elif getattr(app, 'part_alignment', None):
        warns.append("Tilt / Z lean / rotation NOT corrected — Set up was measured on a different CAD file")
    else:
        warns.append("Tilt / Z lean / rotation NOT corrected — not measured in Set up since the app started")
    pt = result.get('pretravel')
    if pt == 'travel':
        items.append(("Pretravel model", "along the probing direction (sloped walls)"))
    elif pt == 'normal':
        warns.append("Sloped-wall pretravel model is OFF (Advanced corrections)")
    if result.get('best_fit'):
        warns.append("Best-fit centre ON — hole POSITIONS are not checked, only size + form")
    return items, warns

def evaluation_kwargs(app) -> dict:

core/evaluation_engine.py::evaluate_points() keys result['holes'] by
hole_id (str of hole.display_id) — a core/*.py-level concept that
knows nothing about app.current_holes. ui/tabs/evaluation_tab.py's
contract expects 'holes' keyed by global index into app.current_holes
instead (matching how every other tab's hover/click hooks already
address holes — see gidx_of in evaluation_tab.py::_draw_overview()).
Mutates result['holes'] in place. Shared by both
ui/evaluation_left_panel.py (after a fresh .log load / refresh) and
ui/evaluation_sidebar_panel.py (after re-running evaluate_points()
with a new tolerance).

def _remap_holes_by_gi(result: dict, current_holes: list) -> None:
    """core/evaluation_engine.py::evaluate_points() keys result['holes'] by
    hole_id (str of hole.display_id) — a core/*.py-level concept that
    knows nothing about app.current_holes. ui/tabs/evaluation_tab.py's
    contract expects 'holes' keyed by global index into app.current_holes
    instead (matching how every other tab's hover/click hooks already
    address holes — see gidx_of in evaluation_tab.py::_draw_overview()).
    Mutates result['holes'] in place. Shared by both
    ui/evaluation_left_panel.py (after a fresh .log load / refresh) and
    ui/evaluation_sidebar_panel.py (after re-running evaluate_points()
    with a new tolerance)."""
    holes_by_id = result.get('holes', {}) or {}
    holes_by_gi = {}
    for gi, h in enumerate(current_holes):
        hid = str(getattr(h, 'display_id', ''))
        if hid in holes_by_id:
            holes_by_gi[gi] = holes_by_id[hid]
    result['holes'] = holes_by_gi

    def refresh(self):
        """อัปเดตทุก label ให้ตรงกับ state ปัจจุบันของ app — เรียกทุกครั้งที่
        สลับเข้าแท็บ Evaluation (_show_evaluation_sidebars) หรือหลังโหลด/
        ประเมินผล .log ใหม่ ไม่ rebuild widget"""
        if not self._built:
            return
        app = self.app

        filename = getattr(app, 'loaded_step_filename', None)
        self.lbl_step_filename.configure(text=filename or "—")

        job = getattr(app, 'job_gcode', None)   # v15
        if job:
            self.lbl_gcode_info.configure(
                text=f"{job['name']}\n{job['points']} probe point(s), {job['lines']} line(s)",
                text_color=theme.TEXT)
        else:
            self.lbl_gcode_info.configure(text="No G-code loaded — Export G-code or Load G-code",
                                          text_color=theme.TEXT_MUTED)

        if app.geo.mesh is not None:
            ext = app.geo.get_physical_dimensions()
            self.lbl_dim_x.configure(text=f"X: {ext[0]:.2f} mm", text_color=theme.TEXT)
            self.lbl_dim_y.configure(text=f"Y: {ext[1]:.2f} mm", text_color=theme.TEXT)
            self.lbl_dim_z.configure(text=f"Z: {ext[2]:.2f} mm", text_color=theme.TEXT)
        else:
            self.lbl_dim_x.configure(text="X: -- mm", text_color=theme.TEXT_MUTED)
            self.lbl_dim_y.configure(text="Y: -- mm", text_color=theme.TEXT_MUTED)
            self.lbl_dim_z.configure(text="Z: -- mm", text_color=theme.TEXT_MUTED)

        # --- Schema source readout ---------------------------------------
        schema        = getattr(app, 'loaded_schema', None)
        loaded_points = getattr(app, 'loaded_expected_points', None)
        if schema is not None and loaded_points:
            source   = getattr(app, 'loaded_expected_points_source', None) or "?"
            view_tag = getattr(app, 'loaded_expected_points_view', None)
            view_tag = f" (view: {view_tag})" if view_tag else ""
            self.lbl_schema_info.configure(
                text=f"Loaded: {source}\n{len(loaded_points)} points{view_tag}\n"
                     f"(hole selection + settings already applied)",
                text_color=theme.TEXT_SECONDARY)
        else:
            self.lbl_schema_info.configure(
                text="Using live hole config (no schema loaded)", text_color=theme.TEXT_MUTED)

        ready = (app.geo.mesh is not None and app.geo.step_data is not None
                and getattr(app, 'holes_detected', False) and app.current_holes)
        self.btn_load_log.configure(state="normal" if ready else "disabled")
        self.btn_record.configure(state="normal" if ready or self._waiting_for_job else "disabled")
        self.btn_load_schema.configure(state="normal" if ready else "disabled")

        result = getattr(app, 'evaluation_result', None)
        # v08: only useful once we actually have cached actual_points to
        # recompute against (i.e. a .log has been parsed at least once).
        can_refresh = bool(result and result.get('_actual_points'))
        self.btn_refresh_results.configure(state="normal" if can_refresh else "disabled")
        self.btn_save_csv.configure(state="normal" if result else "disabled")   # v19

        if result:
            log_name  = result.get('log_filename', '—')
            total_pts = result.get('total_points', 0)
            pts = result.get('_actual_points') or []
            no_wco = bool(pts) and all(p.get('wco') is None for p in pts)
            warn = ""
            if result.get('sequence_mismatch'):   # v12: จำนวนจุด log ≠ schema — จับคู่ได้แค่ส่วนแรก
                warn += (f"\n⚠ Point count differs: log {result.get('actual_count')} vs expected "
                         f"{result.get('expected_count')} — only the first {total_pts} were compared. "
                         f"Wrong schema/log pair?")
                if result.get('actual_count') == 2 * result.get('expected_count', -1):   # v14
                    warn += ("\n  (exactly 2× — a double-touch log without command lines? "
                             "Use the auto-saved log.)")
            if no_wco:
                warn += ("\n⚠ No work offset (WCO) in this log — points are machine\n"
                         "coordinates. Use Evaluate Next Job from OpenBuilds.")
            self.lbl_log_info.configure(
                text=f"Loaded: {log_name}\n{total_pts} points compared" + warn,
                text_color=theme.WARN_TEXT if warn else theme.TEXT_SECONDARY)

            failed = result.get('failed_points', 0)
            if total_pts:
                color = _COLOR_GOOD if failed == 0 else _COLOR_BAD
                self.lbl_failed.configure(
                    text=(f"{failed} of {total_pts} points failed" if failed      # v29: นับจุดไม่ผ่าน
                          else f"All {total_pts} points passed")
                         + (f"\n⚠ {result['suspect_points']} point(s): the stylus shaft may have touched"
                            f" the wall instead of the ball tip — those values may be off"
                            if result.get('suspect_points') else ""),   # v14/v16: เตือนเท่านั้น
                    text_color=color)
            else:
                self.lbl_failed.configure(text="—", text_color=theme.TEXT)

            holes_r = result.get('holes', {}) or {}
            n_holes = len(holes_r)
            n_pass  = sum(1 for hv in holes_r.values() if hv.get('passed'))
            comp = result.get('compensation')
            comp_text = self._calib_text(result)   # v29: การชดเชย/การแก้ค่าอยู่ที่ lbl_corrections
            items, warns = corrections_status(self.app, result)
            self.lbl_corrections.configure(
                text="Corrections:\n" + "\n".join(f"  {h}: {t}" for h, t in items)
                     + "".join(f"\n⚠ {w}" for w in warns),
                text_color=theme.WARN_TEXT if warns else theme.TEXT_MUTED)
            depth_text, depth_warn = self._depth_status_text()   # v13
            shaft_text = self._shaft_risk_text()                   # v17
            depth_text += shaft_text + self._best_fit_text() + self._z_offset_text(result)   # v18 / v27
            depth_warn = depth_warn or bool(shaft_text)
            self.lbl_hole_rate.configure(
                text=((f"{n_pass} / {n_holes} holes fully passed" if n_holes else "") + comp_text
                      + depth_text).lstrip("\n"),
                text_color=(theme.WARN_TEXT if comp == 'unavailable' or depth_warn
                            else theme.TEXT_MUTED),
                justify="left", wraplength=260)
        else:
            self.lbl_log_info.configure(text="No .log file loaded", text_color=theme.TEXT_MUTED)
            self.lbl_failed.configure(text="—", text_color=theme.TEXT)
            self.lbl_hole_rate.configure(text="")
            self.lbl_corrections.configure(text="")

    @staticmethod
    def _z_offset_text(result) -> str:
        """v27: ผลของ estimate_z_offset() เป็นข้อความใต้ Results"""
        z = result.get('z_offset')
        if not z or not z.get('n'):
            return ""
        if not z.get('observable'):
            return "\nZ offset: cannot be found — the probed walls are vertical"
        if z.get('separable'):
            dz, b = z['dz'], z['bias']
            return (f"\nZ offset: real top surface is {abs(dz):.3f} mm {'above' if dz >= 0 else 'below'} Z0"
                    f" (Z0 {'too low' if dz >= 0 else 'too high'} by {abs(dz):.3f})"
                    f"\n  + hole reads {abs(b):.3f} mm {'small' if b >= 0 else 'large'} all round"
                    f" (part size or tip compensation)")
        return (f"\nZ offset ≈ {z['dz_only']:+.3f} mm only IF the hole is exactly CAD size"
                f"\n  — one wall angle: Z and hole size cannot be told apart"
                f" (0.01 mm size error = {0.01 * z['amp']:.3f} mm in Z)")

    @staticmethod
    def _calib_text(result) -> str:
        """v19: สรุป Effective Tip ⌀ จากจุดแตะผนังนอกของรอบนี้"""
        cal = result.get('calibration') or {}
        axes = cal.get('axes') or {}
        if not axes:
            return ""
        parts = []
        for ax, v in axes.items():
            ref = "caliper" if v.get('width_true') else "CAD"
            parts.append(f"{ax} {v['d_eff']:.3f} (span {v['span']:.3f} − {ref} "
                         f"{v['width_true'] or v['width_cad']:.3f})" + ("" if v['ok'] else " ⚠ out of range"))
        return "\nOuter-wall Effective Tip ⌀: " + ", ".join(parts)

    def _on_save_csv(self):
        """v19: บันทึกผลรายจุด — ค่าดิบและค่าหลังชดเชย"""
        result = getattr(self.app, 'evaluation_result', None)
        if not result:
            return
        log_path = result.get('log_path')
        init_dir = os.path.dirname(log_path) if log_path else None
        base = os.path.splitext(result.get('log_filename') or "results")[0]
        path = ctk.filedialog.asksaveasfilename(
            title="Save results CSV", defaultextension=".csv", initialdir=init_dir,
            initialfile=f"{base}_results.csv", filetypes=[("CSV", "*.csv")])
        if not path:
            return
        try:
            from core.evaluation_engine import export_results_csv
            export_results_csv(result, path)
        except Exception as e:
            _mb.showerror("Save failed", f"บันทึก CSV ไม่สำเร็จ:\n{e!r}")
            return
        self.app.notify.show(f"Saved {os.path.basename(path)}", severity="info", duration_ms=4000)

    def _best_fit_text(self) -> str:
        """v18: สรุปการเลื่อนของ Best-fit centre (มากสุดของทุกรู)"""
        result = getattr(self.app, 'evaluation_result', None) or {}
        if not result.get('best_fit'):
            return ""
        offs = [h.get('best_fit_offset') for h in (result.get('holes') or {}).values()]
        offs = [o for o in offs if o]
        if not offs:
            return "\nBest-fit centre: no hole had enough directions to fit"
        mx = max((o[0] ** 2 + o[1] ** 2 + o[2] ** 2) ** 0.5 for o in offs)
        return f"\nBest-fit centre: largest hole shift {mx:.3f} mm (see each hole)"

    def _shaft_risk_text(self) -> str:
        """v17: '⚠ N layer(s) deeper than X mm …' — คำนวณจากขนาดหัวโพรบ ไม่ใช่จากข้อมูลที่วัด"""
        app = self.app
        crit = app.probe_profile.shaft_contact_depth()
        if crit is None:
            return ""
        from core.gcode_generator import layer_depths
        n = 0
        for gi in (getattr(app, 'evaluation_result', None) or {}).get('holes', {}) or {}:
            try:
                n += sum(1 for d in layer_depths(app.current_holes[gi]).values() if d > crit)
            except Exception:
                pass
        if not n:
            return ""
        return (f"\n⚠ {n} layer(s) deeper than {crit:.1f} mm — the stylus shaft may touch the hole "
                f"edge before the ball tip, values there may be off")

    def _on_load_schema(self):
        """loads the schema file AND immediately applies its
        settings_snapshot to app.current_holes (full replace — every
        hole's selection + layers/points/zigzag become exactly what's in
        the file; anything the file doesn't mention gets deselected).
        v08: also auto-refreshes app.evaluation_result if one already
        exists, so Results doesn't go stale after this change."""
        app = self.app

        if not getattr(app, 'holes_detected', False) or not app.current_holes:
            _mb.showwarning("No Holes", "กรุณากด 'Generate Holes' ก่อนโหลด Schema")
            return

        filepath = ctk.filedialog.askopenfilename(
            title="Select Schema (.json)",
            filetypes=[("Schema JSON", "*_schema.json *.json"), ("All Files", "*.*")])
        if not filepath:
            return
        self._load_schema_path(filepath, quiet=False)

    def _load_schema_path(self, filepath: str, quiet: bool) -> bool:
        """v15: โหลด + แทนที่การตั้งค่ารูจาก schema — quiet=True (จาก Load G-code) ไม่มี popup สำเร็จ"""
        app = self.app

        try:
            from core.expected_points_io import load_schema_json
        except ImportError as e:
            _mb.showwarning(
                "Load Schema", f"ยังไม่มี core/expected_points_io.py::load_schema_json() ({e})",
                parent=app.root)
            return

        try:
            data = load_schema_json(filepath)
        except Exception as e:
            _mb.showerror("Load Failed", f"โหลด Schema ไม่สำเร็จ:\n{e!r}")
            return False

        points = data.get('points') or []
        if not points:
            _mb.showwarning("Empty File", "ไฟล์นี้ไม่มี points อยู่เลย")
            return False

        snapshot = data.get('settings_snapshot') or {}

        # --- apply the snapshot to app.current_holes RIGHT NOW — this is
        # the direct-replace the user asked for, no separate button ------
        report = {'matched': 0, 'deselected': 0, 'unmatched': 0, 'total_snapshot_holes': 0}
        if snapshot.get('holes'):
            try:
                from core.evaluation_engine import apply_settings_snapshot
            except ImportError as e:
                _mb.showwarning(
                    "Load Schema", f"ยังไม่มี core/evaluation_engine.py::apply_settings_snapshot() ({e})",
                    parent=app.root)
                return False
            report = apply_settings_snapshot(app.current_holes, snapshot, full_replace=True)

        app.loaded_schema                 = data
        app.loaded_expected_points        = points
        app.loaded_expected_points_source = os.path.basename(filepath)
        app.loaded_expected_points_view   = data.get('view_name')

        # re-sync numbering / treeview / whichever tab is currently open —
        # reuses the exact same refresh path selection-checkbox toggles
        # already use (ui/main_window.py::_refresh_after_inspection_toggle())
        app._refresh_after_inspection_toggle()

        # v08: keep Results in sync with the config we just applied,
        # instead of leaving a stale result from before the load.
        refreshed = self._auto_refresh_if_result_exists()

        self.refresh()
        if hasattr(app, 'evaluation_sidebar_panel'):
            app.evaluation_sidebar_panel.refresh()
        if app.current_tab == "Evaluation":
            app.evaluation_tab.draw_evaluation()
        if quiet:
            return True

        # popup ปกติของ Windows (tkinter.messagebox) แทน toast ของ app.notify ที่ทำให้
        # ทั้งหน้าจอมืดลง
        refresh_tag = "\n\nผลลัพธ์ถูกคำนวณใหม่แล้ว" if refreshed else ""
        if snapshot.get('holes'):
            _mb.showinfo(
                "Schema loaded",
                f"โหลด Schema แล้ว: {os.path.basename(filepath)}\n\n"
                f"แทนที่การตั้งค่าปัจจุบัน: จับคู่ {report['matched']} รู, "
                f"ปิดการเลือก {report['deselected']} รู ({len(points)} points){refresh_tag}",
                parent=app.root)
        else:
            _mb.showwarning(
                "Schema loaded",
                f"โหลด Schema แล้ว: {os.path.basename(filepath)} ({len(points)} points)\n\n"
                f"ไฟล์นี้ไม่มีข้อมูล settings ให้แทนที่ — ใช้ค่าตั้งค่าปัจจุบันต่อไป{refresh_tag}",
                parent=app.root)
        return True

    def _on_clear_schema(self):
        """only clears which points source Evaluation compares the .log
        against (reverts to live-recomputing from app.current_holes as it
        currently stands). Does NOT undo the hole-settings replace that
        already happened on load — there is no undo for that, matching
        the requested direct-replace behavior. v08: also auto-refreshes
        app.evaluation_result if one already exists."""
        app = self.app
        app.loaded_schema                 = None
        app.loaded_expected_points        = None
        app.loaded_expected_points_source = None
        app.loaded_expected_points_view   = None

        refreshed = self._auto_refresh_if_result_exists()

        self.refresh()
        if hasattr(app, 'evaluation_sidebar_panel'):
            app.evaluation_sidebar_panel.refresh()
        if app.current_tab == "Evaluation":

        """เรียกหลัง schema load/clear — ถ้ามีผลตรวจอยู่แล้ว (คือเคยโหลด
        .log มาก่อนหน้านี้ในเซสชันนี้) ให้คำนวณผลใหม่ทันทีด้วย actual_points

    def _evaluate_and_apply(self, actual_points: list, log_filename: str, log_path: str = None) -> bool:
        """แกนกลางที่แท้จริงของการ "ประเมินผลแล้วอัปเดต app.evaluation_result"
        — ใช้ actual_points ที่ได้มาแล้ว (parse ใหม่จาก .log หรือ cache ไว้
        ก็ได้) คำนวณ expected points ตามแหล่งปัจจุบัน (schema ที่โหลดไว้ หรือ
        live จาก app.current_holes), รัน evaluate_points(), ตรวจ settings
        mismatch, แล้ว set app.evaluation_result + รีเฟรช sidebar/แท็บที่
        เกี่ยวข้องทั้งหมด — เป็นจุดเดียวที่ set app.evaluation_result ในไฟล์
        นี้ เรียกจาก _on_load_log(), _on_refresh_results(), และ
        _auto_refresh_if_result_exists()

        Returns True ถ้าคำนวณและอัปเดตสำเร็จ, False ถ้าล้มเหลว (แสดง error
        dialog ให้แล้วภายในฟังก์ชันนี้)"""
        app = self.app

        try:
            from core.evaluation_engine import (
                evaluate_points, build_settings_snapshot, diff_snapshots)
            from core.gcode_generator import build_point_map
        except ImportError as e:
            self.app.notify.show(
                "ยังไม่มีไฟล์คำนวณผล Evaluation ครบ (ต้องมี core/evaluation_engine.py "
                f"และ core/gcode_generator.py::build_point_map() ก่อน)\n\nรายละเอียด: {e}",
                severity="info", duration_ms=6000)
            return False

        selected  = [h for h in app.current_holes if getattr(h, 'selected_for_inspection', False)]
        view_name = getattr(app, 'current_view', 'Top')

        # prefer a loaded Schema's points over live-recomputing from
        # app.current_holes. Since loading a schema now immediately
        # replaces the live hole config to match it, the two are
        # normally in sync anyway — this just avoids recomputing when we
        # already have the exact points that were recorded at export time.
        schema     = getattr(app, 'loaded_schema', None)
        using_json = bool(getattr(app, 'loaded_expected_points', None))
        if using_json:
            expected_points = app.loaded_expected_points
        else:
            try:
                from core.work_zero import machining_origin
                rot = getattr(app, 'screen_rotation', 0)
                origin = machining_origin(app, view_name, rot)   # รวมการเลื่อน Z ตามวิธีตั้ง Z0
                expected_points = build_point_map(selected, view_name, rot, origin,
                                                  z_trigger=app.probe_profile.z_trigger,
                                                  probe_r=app.probe_profile.tip_radius)   # v19
            except Exception as e:
                _mb.showerror("Expected Point Build Failed", f"คำนวณจุดที่คาดหวังไม่สำเร็จ:\n{e!r}")
                return False

        tolerance = getattr(app, 'evaluation_tolerance_mm', 0.5)

        try:
            result = evaluate_points(expected_points, actual_points, tolerance,
                                     **evaluation_kwargs(app))   # v18/v19
        except Exception as e:
            _mb.showerror("Evaluation Failed", f"ประเมินผลไม่สำเร็จ:\n{e!r}")
            return False

        try:   # v27: Z offset จากผนังรูที่เอียง/โค้ง (~50 ms)
            from core.evaluation_engine import estimate_z_offset
            result['z_offset'] = estimate_z_offset(expected_points, actual_points, tolerance,
                                                   **evaluation_kwargs(app))
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[evaluation_left_panel] Z offset failed: {e!r}")
            result['z_offset'] = None

        result['log_filename']         = log_filename
        prev = getattr(app, 'evaluation_result', None) or {}   # v19: refresh ใช้ log เดิม
        result['log_path']             = log_path or (prev.get('log_path')
                                                      if prev.get('log_filename') == log_filename else None)
        result['tolerance_mm']         = tolerance
        result['expected_source']      = 'json' if using_json else 'live'
        result['expected_source_name'] = getattr(app, 'loaded_expected_points_source', None) if using_json else None
        result['_expected_points']     = expected_points
        result['_actual_points']       = actual_points

        # evaluate_points() keys 'holes' by hole_id (display_id string) —
        # remap to global index into app.current_holes, which is what
        # ui/tabs/evaluation_tab.py's contract actually expects.
        _remap_holes_by_gi(result, app.current_holes)

        # --- §6 stale-settings guard (READ-ONLY) -------------------------
        # Always builds a fresh LIVE snapshot for comparison. The
        # reference to compare against is the loaded schema's own
        # settings_snapshot when using one, or the in-memory
        # last_export_snapshot from a live G-code export otherwise.
        try:
            current_snapshot = build_settings_snapshot(app.current_holes, view_name,
                                                       getattr(app, 'screen_rotation', 0))   # ALL holes
        except Exception:
            current_snapshot = None

        if using_json:
            reference_snapshot = (schema or {}).get('settings_snapshot')
        else:
            reference_snapshot = getattr(app, 'last_export_snapshot', None)

        if current_snapshot is not None and reference_snapshot:
            try:
                result['settings_mismatch'] = diff_snapshots(reference_snapshot, current_snapshot)
            except Exception:
                result.setdefault('settings_mismatch', [])
        else:
            result.setdefault('settings_mismatch', [])

        app.evaluation_result = result
        self.refresh()
        if hasattr(app, 'evaluation_sidebar_panel'):
            app.evaluation_sidebar_panel.refresh()
        if app.current_tab == "Evaluation":
            app.evaluation_tab.draw_evaluation()
        return True

    def _on_load_log(self):
        app = self.app

        if app.geo.mesh is None or app.geo.step_data is None:
            _mb.showwarning("No STEP Model", "กรุณาโหลดไฟล์ STEP ก่อน")
            return
        if not getattr(app, 'holes_detected', False) or not app.current_holes:
            _mb.showwarning("No Holes", "กรุณากด 'Generate Holes' ก่อน")
            return

        filepath = ctk.filedialog.askopenfilename(
            title="Select OpenBuilds Control .log file",
            filetypes=[("Log Files", "*.log *.txt"), ("All Files", "*.*")])
        if not filepath:
            return

        try:
            from core.log_parser import parse_openbuilds_log
        except ImportError as e:
            self.app.notify.show(
                f"ยังไม่มี core/log_parser.py ({e})",
                severity="info", duration_ms=6000)
            return

        try:
            actual_points = parse_openbuilds_log(filepath)
        except Exception as e:
            _mb.showerror("Parse Failed", f"อ่านไฟล์ .log ไม่สำเร็จ:\n{e!r}")
            return

        self._evaluate_and_apply(actual_points, os.path.basename(filepath), filepath)

    @staticmethod
    def make_job(path: str, text: str) -> dict:
        """ข้อมูล G-code ที่จะรัน (app.job_gcode) — จุดโพรบ = G38.2 ลบแตะช้าของการแตะสองครั้ง"""
        from core.log_parser import RETOUCH_MARK
        cmds = [ln.split(";")[0].strip() for ln in text.splitlines()]
        cmds = [c for c in cmds if c]
        n_probe = sum(1 for c in cmds if c.upper().startswith("G38.2"))
        n_retouch = sum(1 for c in cmds if c.upper() == RETOUCH_MARK)
        return {'path': path, 'name': os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(path))[0],
                'text': text, 'lines': len(cmds), 'points': n_probe - n_retouch}

    def _on_load_gcode(self):
        app = self.app
        path = ctk.filedialog.askopenfilename(
            title="Select inspection G-code",
            filetypes=[("G-code Files", "*.gcode *.nc *.txt"), ("All Files", "*.*")])
        if not path:
            return
        try:
            with open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
                text = f.read()
        except OSError as e:
            _mb.showerror("Load G-code", f"เปิดไฟล์ไม่สำเร็จ:\n{e}")
            return
        job = self.make_job(path, text)
        if job['points'] == 0:
            _mb.showwarning("Load G-code", "ไฟล์นี้ไม่มีคำสั่งโพรบ (G38.2) — ไม่ใช่ G-code ตรวจรู")
            return
        app.job_gcode = job
        app.last_gcode_name = job['name']     # ใช้ตั้งชื่อไฟล์ log
        schema = os.path.splitext(path)[0] + "_schema.json"
        note = ""
        if os.path.isfile(schema) and getattr(app, 'holes_detected', False) and app.current_holes:
            if self._load_schema_path(schema, quiet=True):
                note = f"\n\nโหลด Schema คู่กันให้แล้ว: {os.path.basename(schema)}"
        elif not os.path.isfile(schema):
            note = ("\n\n⚠ ไม่พบ Schema คู่กัน — ผลตรวจจะเทียบกับค่ารูปัจจุบัน "
                    "ต้องเป็นค่าเดียวกับตอน export G-code นี้")
        self.refresh()
        _mb.showinfo("G-code loaded", f"{job['name']}: {job['points']} probe point(s){note}",
                     parent=app.root)

    def _machine_state(self):
        """(runStatus, alarm) จาก status ล่าสุดของ OpenBuilds — (None, None) ถ้ายังไม่มี"""
        st = getattr(self.app.openbuilds_logger, 'last_status', None) or {}
        comms = st.get("comms") or {}
        return comms.get("runStatus"), comms.get("alarm")

    def _on_toggle_record(self):
        logger = self.app.openbuilds_logger
        if self._waiting_for_job:          # ⏹ Stop
            logger.stop_machine()
            self._set_waiting(False)
            self.lbl_record.configure(text="⏹ Stop sent — machine halted (soft reset). "
                                           "Clear an alarm with $X before the next run.",
                                      text_color=theme.WARN_TEXT)
            return
        app = self.app
        if app.geo.mesh is None or app.geo.step_data is None or not app.current_holes:
            _mb.showwarning("Not Ready", "กรุณาโหลด STEP + Generate Holes (หรือโหลด Schema) ก่อน")
            return
        job = getattr(app, 'job_gcode', None)
        if not job:
            _mb.showwarning("No G-code", "ยังไม่มี G-code — กด Export G-code หรือ 📂 Load G-code ก่อน")
            return
        if not logger.running:
            logger.start()
        if not logger.connected:
            _mb.showwarning("OpenBuilds Control",
                            "ยังไม่ได้เชื่อมต่อ OpenBuilds Control — เปิดโปรแกรมและต่อเครื่องให้เรียบร้อย"
                            " แล้วลองใหม่อีกครั้ง")
            return
        run, alarm = self._machine_state()
        if alarm or (run and str(run).lower() != "idle"):
            _mb.showwarning("Machine not ready",
                            f"เครื่องยังไม่พร้อม (สถานะ: {alarm or run}) — ต้องเป็น Idle ก่อน"
                            + (" (ปลด alarm ด้วย $X)" if alarm else ""))
            return

        if getattr(app, 'work_zero', 'centroid') not in ("center", "upper_left", "upper_right",
                                                         "lower_left", "lower_right"):   # v20
            _mb.showwarning("Work zero",
                            "Work zero เป็น Mesh centroid ซึ่งตั้งบนเครื่องไม่ได้ — เลือก Center หรือมุมใน "
                            "Hardware Setting → Work Zero แล้ว Export G-code ใหม่ก่อน", parent=app.root)
            return

        from ui.centre_check_dialog import ask_centre_ready
        answer = ask_centre_ready(app)
        if answer == "find_centre":   # v20: Set up (ศูนย์ + repeatability + Effective Tip) แล้วกลับมารันต่อ
            app.hardware_setting_dialog.open_setup(on_ready=self._after_setup)
            return
        if answer != "run":
            return
        self._start_job()

    def _after_setup(self):
        """v20: Set up เสร็จ — ตรวจเครื่องอีกรอบแล้วรันตรวจรูต่อ"""
        run, alarm = self._machine_state()
        if alarm or (run and str(run).lower() != "idle"):
            _mb.showwarning("Machine not ready",
                            f"Set up เสร็จแล้ว แต่เครื่องยังไม่พร้อม (สถานะ: {alarm or run}) — "
                            f"รอให้เป็น Idle แล้วกด ▶ Run inspection อีกครั้ง", parent=self.app.root)
            return
        self._start_job(after_setup=True)

    def _start_job(self, after_setup: bool = False):
        """v20: ยืนยันแล้วส่ง G-code ตรวจรูให้ OpenBuilds"""
        app, logger = self.app, self.app.openbuilds_logger
        job = getattr(app, 'job_gcode', None)
        if not job:
            return
        pp = app.probe_profile
        head = (f"Set up เสร็จ — Effective Tip ⌀ = {pp.effective_tip_diameter:.3f} มม.\n"
                f"ลูกบอลค้างอยู่เหนือกึ่งกลาง ห้ามขยับชิ้นงาน\n\n" if after_setup else "")
        if not _mb.askyesno(
                "Run inspection",
                head + f"รัน {job['name']} — {job['points']} จุดโพรบ\n\n"
                f"เครื่องจะเริ่มเคลื่อนที่ทันที มือพร้อมกด ⏹ Stop / e-stop\nเริ่มเลยไหม?",
                parent=app.root):
            return

        cmds = [ln.split(";")[0].strip() for ln in job['text'].splitlines()]
        app.last_gcode_name = job['name']
        logger.ensure_idle_delay()         # v24: $1=255 ก่อนเคลื่อนที่ (ไม่ถาม) — $1 ≠ 255 แกนดีด ~0.4 มม.
        logger.discard_job()               # v26: job ค้างของ Find centre ที่เพิ่งจบ ต้องไม่ถูกบันทึกเป็นงานนี้
        logger.suppress_logs(0)            # job นี้ต้องถูกบันทึก (แม้เพิ่งรัน Find centre)
        try:
            logger.send_gcode("\n".join(c for c in cmds if c))
        except Exception as e:
            _mb.showerror("Run inspection", f"ส่ง G-code ไม่สำเร็จ:\n{e}")
            return
        self._set_waiting(True)

    def _on_ob_event(self, name, payload):
        """v15: ALARM ระหว่างรอ job — ถ้ายังไม่มีจุดโพรบ log จะไม่ถูกบันทึก จึงต้องปลดสถานะรอเอง"""
        if not (self._waiting_for_job and name == "status" and isinstance(payload, dict)):
            return
        alarm = (payload.get("comms") or {}).get("alarm")
        if alarm:
            self.app.root.after(1500, lambda: self._alarm_stop(alarm))

    def _on_job_saved(self, job, path):
        """callback จาก ui/openbuilds_logger.py หลังบันทึกไฟล์ของแต่ละ job"""
        if not self._waiting_for_job:
            return
        self._set_waiting(False)
        if not self.app.openbuilds_logger.auto_log:
            self.app.openbuilds_logger.stop()
        try:
            from core.log_parser import parse_openbuilds_log
            actual_points = parse_openbuilds_log(path)
        except Exception as e:
            _mb.showerror("Parse Failed", f"อ่าน log ไม่สำเร็จ:\n{e!r}")
            return
        self.lbl_record.configure(text=f"Job {job.result} — {job.probe_count} point(s), evaluated:\n{path}",
                                  text_color=theme.OK_TEXT if job.result.startswith("completed")
                                  else theme.WARN_TEXT)
        if self._evaluate_and_apply(actual_points, os.path.basename(path), path):
            csv_path = os.path.splitext(path)[0] + "_results.csv"
            try:   # v19: ผลรายจุด (ดิบ + ชดเชย) ข้าง log ทุกครั้งที่รันจากโปรแกรม
                from core.evaluation_engine import export_results_csv
                export_results_csv(self.app.evaluation_result, csv_path)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"[evaluation] results CSV not written: {e!r}")
                csv_path = None
            self.app.root.after(100, lambda: self._notify_done(job, path, csv_path))   # v20

    def _notify_done(self, job, log_path, csv_path):
        """v20: หน้าต่างแจ้งรันเสร็จ + สรุปผล"""
        res = getattr(self.app, 'evaluation_result', None) or {}
        done = str(job.result).startswith("completed")
        comp = (f"r = {res.get('tip_radius_mm', 0):.3f} mm"
                + (" (outer walls of this run)" if res.get('tip_source') == 'run' else " (Effective Tip from Set up)")
                if res.get('compensation') == 'on' else "off")
        _mb.showinfo(
            "Inspection finished" if done else "Inspection stopped",
            ("รันเสร็จเรียบร้อย ✔" if done else f"รันไม่จบ ({job.result}) — ผลด้านล่างเป็นเท่าที่วัดได้") +
            f"\n\n{res.get('passed_points', 0)} / {res.get('total_points', 0)} จุดผ่าน "
            f"(tolerance {res.get('tolerance_mm', 0):g} มม.)\n"
            f"Tip compensation: {comp}\n\nLog: {log_path}" + (f"\nCSV: {csv_path}" if csv_path else "") +
            "\n\nสลับดูผลแบบชดเชย/ไม่ชดเชย และที่มาของค่าชดเชยได้ที่แผงขวา",
            parent=self.app.root)

def _dir_label(d):
    """v12: ทิศที่โพรบเดินตอนแตะ → 'X−' / 'Y+' / '45°' (ผนังเอียงไม่ตรงแกน)"""
    if not d:
        return ""
    dx, dy = float(d[0]), float(d[1])
    if abs(dx) < 1e-6 and abs(dy) < 1e-6:
        return "Z" + ("−" if float(d[2]) < 0 else "+")
    if abs(dx) >= 0.97 * np.hypot(dx, dy):
        return "X" + ("+" if dx > 0 else "−")
    if abs(dy) >= 0.97 * np.hypot(dx, dy):
        return "Y" + ("+" if dy > 0 else "−")
    return f"{np.degrees(np.arctan2(dy, dx)):.0f}°"

    def build(self, parent):
        self.parent = parent
        for w in parent.winfo_children():
            w.destroy()

        header = ctk.CTkFrame(parent, fg_color="transparent")
        header.pack(pady=(20, 4), padx=20, fill="x")
        ctk.CTkLabel(header, text="Evaluation Results", font=ctk.CTkFont(size=16, weight="bold")).pack(side="left")

        # --- tolerance row ---------------------------------------------
        tol_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(parent, fg_color=theme.BG_CARD, corner_radius=theme.RADIUS)
        tol_frame.pack(padx=20, pady=(0, 5), fill="x")   # v05: การ์ดแรกอยู่ใต้ Tolerance 5 px
        row = ctk.CTkFrame(tol_frame, fg_color="transparent")
        row.pack(fill="x", padx=10, pady=8)
        ctk.CTkLabel(row, text="Tolerance (mm):", text_color=theme.TEXT_SECONDARY).pack(side="left")
        self.tol_entry = ctk.CTkEntry(row, width=70)
        self.tol_entry.insert(0, str(getattr(self.app, 'evaluation_tolerance_mm', 0.5)))
        self.tol_entry.pack(side="left", padx=(8, 8))
        ctk.CTkButton(row, text="Apply", width=70, fg_color=theme.ACCENT, hover_color=theme.ACCENT_HOVER,
                     command=self._on_apply_tolerance).pack(side="left")
        self._pdf_btn = ctk.CTkButton(row, text="Export PDF", width=96, fg_color=theme.BTN_SECONDARY,   # v12
                                      hover_color=theme.BTN_SECONDARY_HOVER, command=self._on_export_pdf)
        self._pdf_btn.pack(side="right")

        # v11: สวิตช์ชดเชยรัศมีหัวโพรบ + ค่าที่ใช้ + ปุ่มที่มาของค่า
        comp = ctk.CTkFrame(parent, fg_color=theme.BG_CARD, corner_radius=theme.RADIUS)
        comp.pack(padx=20, pady=(0, 5), fill="x")
        crow = ctk.CTkFrame(comp, fg_color="transparent")
        crow.pack(fill="x", padx=10, pady=(8, 0))
        self._comp_switch = ctk.CTkSwitch(crow, text="Tip compensation", font=ctk.CTkFont(size=12, weight="bold"),
                                          command=self._on_toggle_comp)
        self._comp_switch.pack(side="left")
        if getattr(self.app, 'evaluation_compensate', True):
            self._comp_switch.select()
        ctk.CTkButton(crow, text="ⓘ Details", width=80, height=24, font=ctk.CTkFont(size=11),
                      fg_color=theme.BTN_SECONDARY, hover_color=theme.BTN_SECONDARY_HOVER,
                      command=self._on_comp_details).pack(side="right")
        self.lbl_comp = ctk.CTkLabel(comp, text="", anchor="w", justify="left", wraplength=300,
                                     font=ctk.CTkFont(size=11), text_color=theme.TEXT_SECONDARY)
        self.lbl_comp.pack(fill="x", padx=10, pady=(2, 8))

        # v05: pack เฉพาะเมื่อมีข้อความเตือน (_pack_warning_frame)
        self.warning_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(parent, fg_color="transparent", height=1)
        self._depth_banner = None

        # corner_radius=0: ขอบโค้งด้านในของ CTkScrollableFrame เว้นที่ว่างด้านบนอีก ~9 px
        self.list_frame = ctk.CTkScrollableFrame(parent, fg_color="transparent", corner_radius=0)
        self.list_frame.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=10, pady=(0, 5))

        self._built = True
        self.refresh()

    def refresh(self):
        """rebuild ทั้งรายการการ์ด — เรียกทุกครั้งที่เข้าแท็บ Evaluation,
        โหลด .log ใหม่ หรือกด Apply tolerance"""
        if not self._built:
            return
        app = self.app

        for w in self.list_frame.winfo_children():
            w.destroy()
        for w in self.warning_frame.winfo_children():
            w.destroy()
        self._depth_banner = None
        self._hole_widgets = {}

        result = getattr(app, 'evaluation_result', None)
        self._refresh_comp(result)   # v11
        if not result:
            # v04: ยังแสดงการ์ดรูได้ (ส่วน Depth + กรอกค่าเวอร์เนียร์) แม้ยังไม่มี .log
            ctk.CTkLabel(
                self.list_frame,
                text="No probe data yet — load or record a .log from the left panel.\n"
                     "Hole depths (CAD) and caliper entries are below.",
                text_color=theme.TEXT_MUTED, font=ctk.CTkFont(size=11), justify="left"
            ).pack(pady=(10, 6), padx=10, anchor="w")
        else:
            self._build_warning_banner(result)

        holes_result = (result or {}).get('holes', {}) or {}
        sel = [(gi, h) for gi, h in enumerate(app.current_holes) if getattr(h, 'selected_for_inspection', False)]
        tol = float((result or {}).get('tolerance_mm', getattr(app, 'evaluation_tolerance_mm', 0.5)) or 0.5)
        self._metrics = {gi: hole_metrics(holes_result[gi], tol, self._depth_info(h)[0])
                         for gi, h in sel if holes_result.get(gi) is not None}
        if result and sel:
            self._build_overall_banner(sel, holes_result, tol)   # v12
        total_pts = sum(m['n'] for m in self._metrics.values())
        self._auto_open = total_pts <= _AUTO_OPEN_POINTS
        any_card = False
        for gi, h in sel:
            info = holes_result.get(gi)
            self._build_hole_card(self.list_frame, gi, h, info)
            any_card = True

        if not any_card:
            ctk.CTkLabel(
                self.list_frame, text="No holes are currently selected for inspection.",
                text_color=theme.TEXT_MUTED, font=ctk.CTkFont(size=12)
            ).pack(pady=20, padx=10)
        self._update_depth_prompts()   # v05: แบนเนอร์ความลึก + แสดง/ซ่อนพื้นที่เตือน

    def _refresh_comp(self, result):
        """v11: ข้อความใต้สวิตช์ — r ที่ใช้และมาจากไหน"""
        app = self.app
        on = bool(getattr(app, 'evaluation_compensate', True))
        if on:
            self._comp_switch.select()
        else:
            self._comp_switch.deselect()
        pp = app.probe_profile
        if not result:
            txt = (f"Will compensate r = {pp.effective_tip_radius:.3f} mm (Effective Tip ⌀ "
                   f"{pp.effective_tip_diameter:.3f})" if on else "Off — raw ball centre vs CAD")
        elif result.get('compensation') == 'on':
            src = ("this run's outer walls" if result.get('tip_source') == 'run'
                   else "Effective Tip from Set up / Hardware Setting")
            txt = (f"Compensating r = {result.get('tip_radius_mm', 0):.3f} mm  (⌀ {2 * result.get('tip_radius_mm', 0):.3f})"
                   f"\nfrom {src}")
        elif result.get('compensation') == 'unavailable':
            txt = "Unavailable — schema has no probe directions (re-export G-code + schema)"
        else:
            txt = "Off — deviations are raw ball centre vs CAD (≈ −r on a perfect part)"
        self.lbl_comp.configure(text=txt, text_color=theme.TEXT_SECONDARY if on else theme.WARN_TEXT)

    def _build_warning_banner(self, result: dict):
        # v03: the §6 stale-settings guard has nothing to warn about when
        # expected points came from a loaded JSON (it IS the frozen
        # source of truth) — ui/evaluation_left_panel.py already forces
        # settings_mismatch = [] in that case, so this banner naturally
        # stays silent for JSON-sourced results without any extra check
        # needed here.
        mismatch = result.get('settings_mismatch') or []
        if mismatch:
            names = ", ".join(str(m) for m in mismatch)
            ctk.CTkLabel(
                self.warning_frame,
                text=f"⚠ Settings changed since export for: {names}\n"
                     f"Results may not reflect the actual machine run.",
                text_color=theme.WARN_TEXT, font=ctk.CTkFont(size=11, weight="bold"),
                wraplength=380, justify="left",
                fg_color=theme.WARN_BG, corner_radius=6
            ).pack(fill="x", pady=(0, 5), ipady=6)
        elif result.get('expected_source') != 'json' and getattr(self.app, 'last_export_snapshot', None) is None:
            ctk.CTkLabel(
                self.warning_frame,
                text="ℹ Settings could not be verified against the actual export — "
                     "results assume the current configuration matches what was run.",
                text_color=theme.TEXT_MUTED, font=ctk.CTkFont(size=10),
                wraplength=380, justify="left"
            ).pack(fill="x", pady=(0, 5))

    def _build_hole_card(self, parent, gi, hole, info):
        """v03 note (Requirement 6): 'info.get(\"passed\")' below comes
        straight from core/evaluation_engine.py's hole_entry['passed'],
        which is True only if EVERY point of this hole passed — a single
        failing point already flips this to False (and the badge to ❌)
        upstream. Nothing in this file needs to re-check that rule."""
        widgets = {'is_expanded': info is not None and getattr(self, '_auto_open', False),
                   'layer_state': {}, 'rendered': False}
        self._hole_widgets[gi] = widgets
        m = getattr(self, '_metrics', {}).get(gi)
        tol = float((getattr(self.app, 'evaluation_result', None) or {}).get('tolerance_mm', 0.5) or 0.5)

        item_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(parent, fg_color="transparent")
        item_frame.pack(fill="x", padx=10, pady=(0, 10))   # v05: ชิดด้านบน

        # v12: ข้อความผลตัวใหญ่เหนือการ์ด — 1 จุดไม่ผ่าน = รูไม่ผ่าน
        if info is None:
            verdict, vcol = "NO DATA — this hole is not in the log", theme.TEXT_MUTED
        elif info.get('passed'):
            verdict, vcol = f"✔ PASS — all {info.get('total_points', 0)} points within ±{tol:g} mm", theme.OK_TEXT
        else:
            nf = info.get('total_points', 0) - info.get('passed_points', 0)
            verdict = (f"✘ FAIL — {nf} of {info.get('total_points', 0)} point{'s' if nf != 1 else ''} "
                       f"outside ±{tol:g} mm")
            vcol = theme.ERR_TEXT
        ctk.CTkLabel(item_frame, text=verdict, text_color=vcol, anchor="w", justify="left", wraplength=380,
                     font=ctk.CTkFont(size=13, weight="bold")).pack(fill="x", padx=2, pady=(0, 2))

        if info is None:
            badge, color = "no data", _COLOR_NODATA
        elif info.get('passed'):
            badge, color = f"PASS all {info.get('total_points', 0)}", _COLOR_PASS
        else:   # v13: นับเฉพาะจุดที่ไม่ผ่าน (ให้ตรงกับข้อความเหนือการ์ด)
            nf = info.get('total_points', 0) - info.get('passed_points', 0)
            badge = f"FAIL {nf} pt{'s' if nf != 1 else ''}"
            color = _COLOR_FAIL
        if m and m.get('max_abs') is not None:
            badge += f"  max {m['max_abs']:.3f}"
        if info is not None and info.get('suspect_points'):   # v06: ก้านโพรบชน — ไม่นับ
            badge += f"  ⚠{info['suspect_points']} stylus?"

        # v08: ชั้นที่ลึกเกินจุดที่ก้านโพรบแตะขอบปากรู (คำนวณจากเรขาคณิต)
        crit = self.app.probe_profile.shaft_contact_depth()
        try:
            from core.gcode_generator import layer_depths
            depths = layer_depths(hole)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[evaluation_sidebar_panel] layer depths failed: {e!r}")
            depths = {}
        risky = sorted(i for i, d in depths.items() if crit is not None and d > crit)
        widgets.update(layer_depths=depths, shaft_crit=crit)
        if risky:
            badge += f"  ⚠ stylus L{','.join(str(i + 1) for i in risky)}"

        floor, length, _parts = self._depth_info(hole)   # v04: ความลึกบนหัวการ์ด
        depth_tag = (f"   ↧{floor:.2f}" if floor is not None else
                     f"   ↧{length:.2f} thru" if length is not None else "")
        btn = ctk.CTkButton(
            item_frame, text=f"Hole {hole.display_id}   {badge}{depth_tag}", anchor="w",
            fg_color=color, hover_color=color,
            command=lambda: self._toggle_hole(gi))
        btn.pack(fill="x")
        widgets['btn'] = btn
        widgets['btn_text'] = f"Hole {hole.display_id}   {badge}{depth_tag}"   # v05
        widgets.update(hole=hole, floor=floor, fp=_hole_fingerprint(hole),
                       probed_floor=bool((info or {}).get('floor')))

        def enter(e, g=gi):
            if self.app.current_tab == "Evaluation" and hasattr(self.app, 'evaluation_tab'):
                self.app.evaluation_tab.highlight_hole(g)

        def leave(e):
            if self.app.current_tab == "Evaluation" and hasattr(self.app, 'evaluation_tab'):
                self.app.evaluation_tab.clear_hole_highlight()

        self._bind_hover_recursive(item_frame, enter, leave)

        body = ctk.CTkFrame(item_frame, fg_color=theme.BG_INPUT, corner_radius=6)
        widgets['body'] = body
        self._build_depth_block(body, hole, info, gi)   # v04

        if info is None:
            ctk.CTkLabel(
                body, text=("No matching probe data found for this hole in the log."
                            if getattr(self.app, 'evaluation_result', None) else "No probe data yet."),
                text_color=theme.TEXT_MUTED, font=ctk.CTkFont(size=11),
                wraplength=280, justify="left"
            ).pack(padx=10, pady=8, anchor="w")
        else:
            self._build_summary_block(body, info, m, tol)   # v12: max |dev|, ความกลม %, จุดลึกสุด
            bf = info.get('best_fit_offset')   # v09: ตำแหน่งรูจริงเยื้องจาก CAD = −(การเลื่อน)
            if bf:
                d = (bf[0] ** 2 + bf[1] ** 2 + bf[2] ** 2) ** 0.5
                ctk.CTkLabel(
                    body, text=(f"Best-fit centre: hole is {d:.3f} mm from CAD position\n"
                                f"(ΔX {-bf[0]:+.3f}  ΔY {-bf[1]:+.3f}  ΔZ {-bf[2]:+.3f}) — not counted"),
                    text_color=theme.WARN_TEXT, font=ctk.CTkFont(size=11), justify="left"
                ).pack(anchor="w", padx=10, pady=(0, 2))
            widgets['info'] = info
        if widgets['is_expanded']:
            self._render_body(gi)
            body.pack(fill="x", pady=(4, 0))

    def _build_overall_banner(self, sel, holes_result, tol):
        """v12: ผลรวมทุกรูบนสุดของรายการ"""
        n_fail = sum(1 for gi, _h in sel if holes_result.get(gi) is not None and not holes_result[gi].get('passed'))
        n_nod = sum(1 for gi, _h in sel if holes_result.get(gi) is None)
        n_ok = len(sel) - n_fail - n_nod
        pts_f = sum(m['failed'] for m in self._metrics.values())
        pts_n = sum(m['n'] for m in self._metrics.values())
        if n_fail:
            text, fg, tc = (f"✘ PART FAILS\n{n_fail} of {len(sel)} hole{'s' if len(sel) != 1 else ''} failed  ·  "
                            f"{pts_f} of {pts_n} points outside ±{tol:g} mm"), theme.ERR_BG, theme.ERR_TEXT
        elif n_nod:
            text, fg, tc = (f"⚠ INCOMPLETE\n{n_ok} passed, {n_nod} hole(s) without data"), theme.WARN_BG, theme.WARN_TEXT
        else:
            text, fg, tc = (f"✔ PART PASSES\nall {len(sel)} hole{'s' if len(sel) != 1 else ''}, "
                            f"{pts_n} points within ±{tol:g} mm"), theme.OK_BG, theme.OK_TEXT
        f = ctk.CTkFrame(self.list_frame, fg_color=fg, corner_radius=6)
        f.pack(fill="x", padx=10, pady=(4, 10))
        ctk.CTkLabel(f, text=text, text_color=tc, font=ctk.CTkFont(size=13, weight="bold"),
                     wraplength=440, justify="left", anchor="w").pack(fill="x", padx=10, pady=8)

    def _build_summary_block(self, parent, info, m, tol):
        """v12: ค่าสำคัญของรู — max |dev|, % ความเป็นวงกลมต่อชั้น, จุดลึกสุด"""
        if not m:
            return
        lines = [f"Max |dev| {m['max_abs']:.3f} mm  (tolerance ±{tol:g})" if m['max_abs'] is not None
                 else f"Max Offset: {info.get('max_deviation', 0):.3f} mm"]
        circ = [l for l in m['layers'] if l['circularity'] is not None]
        if circ:
            lines.append("Roundness (mm)  " + "   ".join(f"L{l['layer'] + 1} {l['roundness']:.3f}" for l in circ))
            lines.append("Roundness margin  " + "   ".join(f"L{l['layer'] + 1} {l['circularity']:.0f}%" for l in circ))
            lines.append("   = 100 × (1 − roundness / tolerance)")
        dp = m['deepest']
        if dp['method'] == 'sphere':
            lines.append(f"Deepest point {dp['depth']:.3f} mm   (CAD {dp['cad']:.3f}, {dp['error']:+.3f})")
            lines.append(f"   sphere fit R {dp['sphere_r']:.3f} (CAD {dp['sphere_r_cad']:.3f})")
        elif dp['method'] == 'floor':
            lines.append(f"Deepest point {dp['depth']:.3f} mm — floor probed   (CAD {dp['cad']:.3f}, {dp['error']:+.3f})")
        else:
            cad = f"  (CAD floor {dp['cad']:.2f})" if dp.get('cad') is not None else ""
            lines.append(f"Deepest probed {dp['depth']:.2f} mm{cad}" if dp.get('depth') is not None
                         else "Deepest point: —")
            if dp['method'] == 'sphere_flat':
                lines.append(f"   sphere fit R {dp['sphere_r']:.3f} (CAD {dp['sphere_r_cad']:.3f})")
                lines.append("   flat floor below the sphere is not reachable")
            else:
                lines.append("   = lowest layer; the floor is not reachable")
                lines.append("     from the walls — use Caliper depth")
        ctk.CTkLabel(parent, text="\n".join(lines), anchor="w", justify="left",
                     text_color=theme.TEXT_SECONDARY, font=ctk.CTkFont(family=theme.FONT_MONO, size=10)
                     ).pack(fill="x", padx=10, pady=(8, 4))

    def _build_layer_row(self, parent, gi, seg_idx, layer: dict):
        layer_idx = layer.get('layer_idx', 0)
        key = (gi, seg_idx, layer_idx)
        state = self._hole_widgets[gi]['layer_state'].setdefault(
            key, {'expanded': True, 'show_all': True})   # v12: เปิดทุกชั้น แสดงทุกจุด

        row = ctk.CTkFrame(parent, fg_color=theme.BG_CARD_HOVER, corner_radius=5)
        row.pack(fill="x", padx=4, pady=2)

        pts = layer.get('points', [])
        nf = sum(1 for p in pts if not p.get('passed', True))
        badge = "✔ PASS" if layer.get('passed') else f"✘ FAIL {nf} of {len(pts)}"
        mx = max((abs(float(p['dev'])) for p in pts if p.get('dev') is not None),
                 default=layer.get('max_deviation', 0))
        hw = self._hole_widgets[gi]
        depth = (hw.get('layer_depths') or {}).get(layer_idx)
        crit = hw.get('shaft_crit')
        text = f"{badge}   Layer {layer_idx + 1}" + (f"   depth {depth:.1f}" if depth is not None else "")
        text += f"   max |dev| {mx:.3f}"
        lm = next((l for l in ((getattr(self, '_metrics', {}).get(gi) or {}).get('layers') or [])
                   if l['seg'] == seg_idx and l['layer'] == layer_idx), None)

        if depth is not None and crit is not None and depth > crit:   # v08: คำนวณจากเรขาคณิต
            text += (f"\n   ⚠ deeper than {crit:.1f} mm: the stylus shaft"
                     f"\n      may touch the hole edge before the ball tip"
                     f"\n      triggers — this layer may be off")
        if layer.get('shaft_suspect'):   # v06: ผนังเข้ามาใกล้กว่าชั้นบน — ก้านแตะก่อนลูกบอล
            text += (f"\n   ⚠ stylus shaft may touch the wall instead of the ball tip"
                     f"\n      (walls {layer.get('wall_shift', 0):+.2f} mm vs top layer) — values may be off")
        ctk.CTkButton(
            row, text=text, anchor="w",
            fg_color="transparent", hover_color=theme.SELECT_BG,
            text_color=theme.OK_TEXT if layer.get('passed') else theme.ERR_TEXT,   # v12
            font=ctk.CTkFont(size=11, weight="bold"),
            command=lambda: self._toggle_layer(gi, seg_idx, layer_idx)
        ).pack(fill="x", padx=4, pady=4)

        circ = layer.get('circle')   # least-squares circle fit ของชั้นนี้ (เฉพาะรูกลม)
        if circ:
            rnd = circ.get('roundness')
            raw_d = circ.get('raw_center_diameter')
            lines = [
                f"⌀ {circ['measured_diameter']:.3f}  (CAD {circ['nominal_diameter']:.3f}, "
                f"{circ['diameter_error']:+.3f})",
                f"Centre offset {circ['center_offset']:.3f}   Roundness "
                + (f"{rnd:.3f}" if rnd is not None else "n/a (needs ≥ 4 pts)")
                + (f"   Margin {lm['circularity']:.0f}%" if lm and lm['circularity'] is not None else ""),
            ]
            if raw_d is not None:
                lines.append(f"Ball-centre ⌀ {raw_d:.3f} (for tip calibration)")
            ctk.CTkLabel(
                row, text="\n".join(lines), anchor="w", justify="left",
                text_color=theme.OK_TEXT if circ.get('passed') else theme.ERR_TEXT,
                font=ctk.CTkFont(family=theme.FONT_MONO, size=10)
            ).pack(fill="x", padx=12, pady=(0, 6))

        table_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(row, fg_color="transparent")
        state['table_frame'] = table_frame
        state['layer'] = layer
        if state['expanded']:
            table_frame.pack(fill="x", padx=6, pady=(0, 6))
            self._render_point_table(table_frame, gi, seg_idx, layer_idx)

    def _render_point_table(self, parent, gi, seg_idx, layer_idx):
        key = (gi, seg_idx, layer_idx)
        state = self._hole_widgets[gi]['layer_state'][key]
        layer = state['layer']

        for w in parent.winfo_children():
            w.destroy()

        points = layer.get('points', [])
        if state['show_all']:
            shown = points
        else:
            shown = [p for p in points if not p.get('passed', True)]
            if not shown:
                # nothing failed in this layer — showing "failed only" would
                # just be an empty table, so fall back to showing everything
                shown = points

        toggle_text = "Show failed only" if state['show_all'] else "Show all points"
        ctk.CTkButton(
            parent, text=toggle_text, width=140, height=22,
            fg_color=theme.BTN_SECONDARY, hover_color=theme.BTN_SECONDARY_HOVER, font=ctk.CTkFont(size=10),
            command=lambda: self._toggle_show_all(gi, seg_idx, layer_idx)
        ).pack(anchor="w", pady=(2, 4))

        # v03: "Expected"/"Actual"/"Δ(mm)" -> "Ideal"/"Measured"/"Offset(mm)"
        # (Requirement 5 wording — same underlying fields, display only)
        header = ctk.CTkFrame(parent, fg_color="transparent")
        header.pack(fill="x")
        # v12: + ทิศที่แตะ, dev มีเครื่องหมาย (− = เนื้อชิ้นงานเกิน/รูเล็ก, + = เนื้อหาย/รูใหญ่)
        for text, w in (("#", 20), ("Dir", 30), ("Ideal (x, y, z)", 118), ("Measured", 118), ("Dev", 52), ("", 40)):
            ctk.CTkLabel(header, text=text, text_color=theme.TEXT_MUTED,
                        font=ctk.CTkFont(size=9, weight="bold"), width=w).pack(side="left")

        for p in shown:
            exp  = p.get('expected', (0.0, 0.0, 0.0))
            act  = p.get('actual', (0.0, 0.0, 0.0))
            dev  = p.get('dev')
            dist = p.get('distance_mm', 0.0)
            ok   = p.get('passed', False)
            sus  = bool(p.get('suspect'))   # v06: ก้านชน — ไม่นับ

            # v03: explicit green/red ROW background (Requirement 5),
            # not just text color on the offset column.
            row_color = _ROW_PASS if ok else _ROW_FAIL
            r = ctk.CTkFrame(parent, fg_color=row_color, corner_radius=3)
            r.pack(fill="x", pady=1)

            ctk.CTkLabel(r, text=str(p.get('point_idx', '?')), width=20,
                        font=ctk.CTkFont(size=9)).pack(side="left", pady=2)
            ctk.CTkLabel(r, text=_dir_label(p.get('dir')), width=30,
                        font=ctk.CTkFont(size=9)).pack(side="left", pady=2)
            ctk.CTkLabel(r, text=f"{exp[0]:.2f}, {exp[1]:.2f}, {exp[2]:.2f}", width=118,
                        font=ctk.CTkFont(size=9)).pack(side="left", pady=2)
            ctk.CTkLabel(r, text=f"{act[0]:.2f}, {act[1]:.2f}, {act[2]:.2f}", width=118,
                        font=ctk.CTkFont(size=9)).pack(side="left", pady=2)
            ctk.CTkLabel(r, text=f"{dev:+.3f}" if dev is not None else f"{dist:.3f}", width=52,
                        font=ctk.CTkFont(size=10, weight="bold"),
                        text_color=(theme.OK_TEXT if ok else theme.ERR_TEXT)
                        ).pack(side="left", pady=2)
            ctk.CTkLabel(r, text=("PASS" if ok else "FAIL") + (" ⚠" if sus else ""), width=40,
                        font=ctk.CTkFont(size=9, weight="bold"),
                        text_color=(theme.OK_TEXT if ok else theme.ERR_TEXT)).pack(side="left", pady=2)

        if not points:
            ctk.CTkLabel(parent, text="No points recorded for this layer.",
                        text_color=theme.TEXT_FAINT, font=ctk.CTkFont(size=10)).pack(anchor="w", pady=(4, 0))

(ความลึกพื้นตาม CAD หรือ None ถ้ารูทะลุ, ความยาวรูตาม CAD, ['⌀.. : a–b mm', ...])

    @staticmethod
    def _depth_info(hole):
        """(ความลึกพื้นตาม CAD หรือ None ถ้ารูทะลุ, ความยาวรูตาม CAD, ['⌀.. : a–b mm', ...])"""
        sh = getattr(hole, '_step_hole', None)
        if sh is None:
            return None, None, []
        o = np.asarray(sh.open_3d, dtype=float)
        parts = []
        segs = getattr(sh, 'segments', None) or []
        if len(segs) > 1:
            for seg in reversed(segs):   # segments เรียงลึกสุดก่อน — แสดงจากปากรูลงไป
                a = float(np.linalg.norm(np.asarray(seg.open_3d, dtype=float) - o))
                b = float(np.linalg.norm(np.asarray(seg.deep_3d, dtype=float) - o))
                parts.append(f"⌀{2 * max(seg.radius_open, seg.radius_deep):.2f}: "
                             f"{min(a, b):.2f} – {max(a, b):.2f} mm")
        return hole_floor_depth(sh), float(sh.depth), parts

    def _save_manual_depth(self, fp: str, value):
        all_ = user_settings.get("manual_depths", {}) or {}
        key = getattr(self.app, 'loaded_step_filename', None) or "?"
        mine = all_.get(key, {}) or {}
        if value is None:
